newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors indict Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors indict Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank - Jiji.

text.p: Prosecutors indicted Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) for allegedly violating Japan's Banking Law, Jiji news agency reported on Monday.
DKB could not immediately confirm the report.
On Friday, Tokyo prosecutors indicted former DKB chairman Tadashi Okuda on charges of extending 11.78 billion yen in loans to a "sokaiya" corporate racketeer.

Also on Friday, Japan's Finance Ministry filed a complaint with Tokyo prosecutors against DKB and several former DKB executives for allegedly violating the Banking Law by hiding from ministry investigators information about loans to the sokaiya racketeer.
